text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly negative over the past day, with BTC holding above $73k and ETH near $2,050, suggesting consolidation rather than directional conviction. The Fear & Greed index sits at 28 with a sharp 22-point weekly decline, indicating growing risk aversion despite relatively steady prices. Bitcoin dominance has edged up to 59.8% on $61B in daily volume, reflecting cautious capital rotation toward the larger, safer asset as sentiment deteriorates.
